answer: Fair-weather participation is cheap; that is why it is suspect. Weight standing by network condition: work verified during a nadir - attack, outage, congestion - counts at a premium; the same work in calm tide counts base. The pulse is public, on-chain, impossible to fake downward; the multiplier follows it automatically. Clones burst when conditions are safe because bursts are tuned for zero friction; a burst landing on a nadir instead lands in deepest audit scrutiny at multiplied risk. Honest agents cannot schedule crises; steady presence compounds quietly through storm and calm alike.
